cases.name: Katherine Ann Olson
cases.about:
Her Find-a Grave entry says, "Katherine was funny, sweet, smart and outgoing. She was an extremely kind and caring person and she never treated anyone badly. She had a wonderful energy about her. She had a bright spirit. She accepted people for who they were. never talked bad about anyone. She was very sharp, quick to point out something dumb when she saw it, but always with good humor, and never at the expense of any of the people around her. She was such a pleasure to be around and was one of the nicest people you could ever meet. She believed that humanity was better than it is, and that it could be made better than it is.

Katherine was in drama club and the one-act play in high school. She was on the nordic ski team. She had a zest for life. She had a zest for travel and she had a great love for children. She brightened up every room when she entered it and made people laugh and happy. Katherine was such a shiny person. She has profoundly touched the lives of so many people around the world and is missed dearly.

Remembering Katherine-
Katherine Ann Olson was energetic, exuberant, vivacious, intensely curious, creative, and talented. She was passionate about life.

Whether she was performing in choir, acting in a play, or mentoring her Latina "little sister," Katherine was a role model. She achieved honors of co-valedictorian of her high school class and graduated summa cum laude from St. Olaf College. Following college, she taught Spanish lessons to elementary students, nannied, waitressed, and coached the Saint Paul Highland Park High School speech team. Preparing to study in Spain in the fall of 2008 for her master's degree in Spanish, Katherine hoped to become a professor, combining her loves of Spanish, youth and performance."
cases.narrative:
On 10/26/2007, her body was found in the trunk of her car in Burnsville Nature Preserve. He lured her via a Craiglist ad for a nanny position.

Posing as a married woman named "Amy" who was looking for nanny services, Anderson exchanged emails with Olson. When she arrived at his parents' house for an interview, he shot her in the back with a .357 Magnum and put her body into the trunk of her car.
